items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Miles created an original melody of his own on Bobby Troup’s tune.

ctx.x: Oh, it's got nothing to do with what Miles played. Miles created an original melody of his own on Bobby Troup’s tune.
[Michael] Brecker did that, too, on [the recording] Don't Try This . . . I can’t remember which album it's on that he does The Meaning of the Blues. [It's on Now You See It . . . (Now You Don't).]
